strategy.thesis: Equity crowdfunding / online venture investing platform that gives accredited investors worldwide access to vetted startup and fund deals, co-investing alongside its members in each round.

application.how_to_apply: Startups can apply for funding via the OurCrowd website; investors register as accredited members.

summary.en: OurCrowd is a Jerusalem-based global online venture investing platform founded in 2013 by Jon Medved. It lets accredited investors worldwide co-invest in startups and funds curated by OurCrowd, which leads or joins each deal. It manages over $2.6B and has registered 240,000+ members across 195 countries, with 500+ portfolio companies and 70+ exits including Lemonade, Beyond Meat and CyberX.

strategy.thesis: Women-led online investment platform giving accredited investors worldwide curated, due-diligence-vetted access to Israeli tech startups via co-investment syndicates and managed VC funds.

application.how_to_apply: Investors register on iAngels platform; startups are sourced through iAngels' proprietary due-diligence pipeline.

summary.en: iAngels is a women-led Tel Aviv investment platform founded in 2014 by Shelly Hod Moyal, Mor Assia and David Assia. It lets accredited investors worldwide co-invest in curated Israeli tech startups via syndicates/SPVs and managed VC funds. It has over $400M AUM, a global network of ~20,000 members, ~24 profitable exits (eToro, Arbe, Applitools), and closed a $55.5M first institutional fund anchored by the European Investment Fund in 2021.

summary.en: IL Angel Club is a private angel investor network founded in September 2024 by Ram Yonish and backed by the Israel Innovation Authority (one of the 8 Angel Club tender winners). It connects 200+ Israeli and international investors with validated pre-seed/seed Israeli startups on a deal-by-deal basis with no membership fees. Average allocation is ~$250K per round; it reports 11 portfolio companies and aims to grow to 2,000 investors within 24 months.

summary.en: Hasoub Angels (formerly the Arab Angels Club) is an angel investment club founded in 2013 in Ar'ara as an initiative of the Hasoub NGO, dedicated to building the entrepreneurial ecosystem in Arab society in Israel. It is industry-agnostic but stage-specific (early-stage tech), pools members' capital and expertise, and runs training programs for new investors. Its alumni have invested roughly $1 million to date.
